# Drag, Ordering & Concurrency Checklist: Board — grouping, drag and ordering

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements governing the drop gesture — its accessibility, the fractional-index ordering it writes, the optimistic overlay it renders under a thirty-second poll, and the server-side authorization on `moveIssue` — are complete, unambiguous, consistent and measurable before implementation begins
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness — the drop gesture

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for a second drop of the same card issued while that card's first drop is still in flight — serialized, coalesced, or refused? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what happens when the lane being dragged over is removed by a re-query mid-gesture, as distinct from the dragged card itself vanishing? [Gap, Spec §FR-055, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the drop indicator — the affordance showing where a card will land between two neighbours — specified as a requirement, given that FR-043 forbids conveying state through colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how long a pending optimistic drop may remain unsettled before the board acts, for a call that neither resolves nor rejects? [Gap, Spec §FR-041, §FR-045, §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a recovery path specified for a card that cannot be placed between two tied neighbours, or is `no_index_available` a dead end the user must resolve by some unstated means? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for where a card created by the composer appears relative to an in-flight optimistic drop overlay that has not yet settled? [Gap, Spec §FR-049, §FR-050, §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements stated for whether an accepted drop must produce any confirmation an assistive-technology user can perceive, or is silence on success intended? [Gap, Spec §FR-043, §SC-015]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK008 Is "the exact position it came from" defined for a rollback whose origin neighbours were themselves changed by a re-query that landed during the in-flight call? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-041, §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "no connection" defined with an observable condition distinguishing it from a slow or timed-out server, given that FR-045 mandates a distinct message for it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-045]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "on the next render" bounded in time for a member whose membership is revoked while their board is open, given that only the thirty-second poll forces a render? [Clarity, Spec §FR-066]
- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-005's "hundred drops including deliberate ties" be executed as written — is the mechanism by which a tie is *produced* specified anywhere, given that no writer may emit a duplicate index? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-012's "renders identically for a member and a non-member" defined precisely enough to be verified, given that affordances are required to differ? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the lane count in FR-009 specified as counting the optimistically rendered set or the last server-confirmed set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the relationship between the focus-triggered re-query and the thirty-second interval specified — does a focus refresh reset the interval, and may two refreshes overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-054]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "the board refreshes" after a `not_found` refusal specified as an immediate re-query or as reliance on the next scheduled one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034, US5 sc.8]

## Requirement Consistency & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK016 Do FR-033's `isMember` gate and FR-068's admin-without-a-membership-row rule state consistently whether an admin satisfies the membership predicate, or is the reconciliation left implicit? [Conflict, Spec §FR-033, §FR-068]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the refusal for a **deactivated user who holds no issue in this project** unambiguous, given FR-034 classes "neither in the pool nor still assigned here" as a missing row while FR-035 classes "exists but is not legal" as an invalid target? [Conflict, Spec §FR-034, §FR-035, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the four refusal outcomes enumerated identically in the spec and the mutator contract, with no fifth outcome for malformed input implied anywhere? [Consistency, Spec §FR-041, Contract `mutators.md`]
- [ ] CHK019 Do FR-056 (the caller's own overlay survives a re-query) and FR-058 (nothing renders from a client cache on a revisit) state a consistent rule about what client-held state is permitted to outlive a server read? [Consistency, Spec §FR-056, §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK020 Do FR-041's optimistic-apply rule and FR-050's wait-for-server rule state clearly enough why one write on this screen is optimistic and the other is not, so neither is applied to the wrong gesture? [Consistency, Spec §FR-041, §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK021 Is FR-054's mandated timer consistent with the no-polling rule an earlier entry established for its own feed, and is that boundary recorded in the requirements rather than only in research? [Consistency, Spec §FR-054, Research §D-3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the lane sets and their ordering stated consistently between the spec's FR-017/FR-018/FR-019 and the data model's lane table, including the third assignee group? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, `data-model.md`]

## Scenario Coverage — keyboard and accessibility

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for how a keyboard user reaches a lane that is off-screen, given that FR-006 mandates horizontal scrolling and no responsive layout? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the distinction between activating a card (opening the issue) and initiating a keyboard drag specified, so that one gesture cannot be mistaken for the other? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-013, §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK025 Are accessible-name requirements stated for every drop target under all three groupings, including **Unassigned** and a lane that accepts no drop? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for how a lane that refuses drops communicates that refusal to a keyboard or screen-reader user before the gesture is attempted, not only in the composer's placeholder? [Gap, Spec §FR-037, §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for abandoning a keyboard drag, equivalent to FR-042's Escape and drop-outside-any-lane cases for pointer drags? [Coverage, Spec §FR-042, §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the accessibility obligations stated as testable acceptance criteria given that the chosen test approach cannot simulate a pointer drag? [Measurability, Spec §SC-015, Research §F-4]

## Edge Case Coverage — ordering and concurrency

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for two concurrent drops resolving into the *same* gap, which is the one path by which a tie can arise without any writer emitting a duplicate? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-057, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the requirement that the written index sort strictly between its neighbours stated in terms of the same `(sort_order, id)` ordering the board reads, including when the tie-break rather than the index decides the position? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for a drop whose named neighbour has moved to a different lane between render and write, distinct from one whose row was deleted? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the no-op conditions defined precisely — is "the position it already occupies" evaluated against the client's rendered order or the server's freshly read order? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements stated for the consequence FR-025 accepts — that a reorder under one grouping moves the card under the others — as an outcome users are told about, or only as one the board must not compensate for? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the absence of any renumbering, rebalancing or repair path stated as a requirement that can be verified negatively, rather than only as an intention? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024, §SC-005]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 Are performance or scale requirements defined for a board's card count, given that FR-006 forbids pagination and the edge cases accept a lane of hundreds? [Gap, NFR, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Are latency expectations specified for the interval between a drop and its settled state, given that FR-041 makes the optimistic render the user's only immediate feedback? [Gap, NFR, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK037 Are requirements defined for the cost or frequency limits of the thirty-second re-query on a board with many lanes and cards? [Gap, NFR, Spec §FR-054]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that the ordering scheme's key generator throws exactly when two neighbours are equal — and never otherwise — recorded as a validated dependency rather than an inference? [Assumption, Spec §FR-031, Research §A-3]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that the drag library supplies every keyboard, focus and ARIA behaviour FR-043 requires, with nothing hand-rolled, recorded and validated? [Assumption, Spec §FR-044, §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the downstream obligation that a later entry will add a notification write inside this feature's transaction recorded in a way that does not require a seam to be built now? [Dependency, Spec *Downstream reach-back*]
- [ ] CHK041 Is the inherited approved-dependency discrepancy flagged in research recorded where a reviewer applying the dependency gate will find it, with its resolution assigned outside this feature? [Assumption, Research *One question this plan raises*]

## Ambiguities & Scope Boundaries

- [ ] CHK042 Is it stated as an accepted consequence that a user who leaves the board through the composer's chevron and returns loses their grouping choice, given FR-020 forbids persisting or URL-encoding it? [Ambiguity, Scope, Spec §FR-020, §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the boundary between the client's rendered affordances and the server's enforcement stated once, unambiguously, for every control this feature adds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-065, §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK044 Are the activity-row requirements bounded — is the truncation of a frozen display string to the stored length limit stated in the requirements or only in the data model? [Gap, Spec §FR-060, `data-model.md`]

## Notes

- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
